segments.text: Good morning everyone. Let's look at the big picture for Q3.
Sales are up, but we have some challenges ahead.
If you direct your attention to the screen right now...
...you will clearly see the revenue chart for October.
Notice this sharp dip right here around the 15th.
We recovered quickly, as I see it.
Now let's turn to page four of the printed report.
This graph outlines our user growth.
